propertySets.name: Pset_PipeConnectionFlanged
propertySets.definition: This property set is used to define the specifics of a flanged pipe connection used between occurrences of pipe segments and fittings.

properties.name: FlangeTable
properties.definition: Designation of the standard table to which the flange conforms.

properties.name: FlangeStandard
properties.definition: Designation of the standard describing the flange table.

properties.name: BoreSize
properties.definition: The nominal bore of the pipe flange.

properties.name: FlangeThickness
properties.definition: Thickness of the material from which the pipe bend is constructed.

properties.name: NumberOfBoltholes
properties.definition: Number of boltholes in the flange.

properties.name: BoltSize
properties.definition: Size of the bolts securing the flange.

properties.name: BoltholePitch
properties.definition: Diameter of the circle along which the boltholes are placed.

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: PressureRange
properties.definition: Allowable maximum and minimum working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

properties.name: NominalDiameter
properties.definition: Nominal diameter or width of the object.

properties.name: InnerDiameter
properties.definition: The actual inner diameter of the object.

properties.name: OuterDiameter
properties.definition: The actual outer diameter of the object.

propertySets.name: Qto_PipeSegmentBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all types and occurrences of pipe segments.
